SELECT DATE_FORMAT(reserved_at, '%Y%m%d') AS reserveDate, HOUR(reserved_at) AS reserveHour, COUNT(*) AS reservationCount FROM `clinic_system_db`.`reservations` WHERE reserved_at >= #{startDate} AND reserved_at < #{endDate}
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(reserved_at, '%Y%m%d'), HOUR(reserved_at)

SELECT r.id AS id, r.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, DATE_FORMAT(r.reserved_at, '%H:%i') AS reserve_time FROM `clinic_system_db`.`reservations` r INNER JOIN `clinic_system_db`.`customers` c ON r.customer_id = c.id WHERE DATE(r.reserved_at) = #{targetDate} ORDER BY r.reserved_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservations ( customer_id, status, reserved_at, temporary_expires_at, canceled_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{customerId}, #{status}, #{reservedAt}, #{temporaryExpiresAt}, #{canceledAt}, #{createdAt} )
